# CHUM — A Tribute to Phish (Complete Reference, Repertoire & Venue History)

> San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute and improvisational rock/jam band active since 2010, performing 200+ songs spanning Phish's multi-era catalog (1.0–4.0) alongside 70+ classic rock, funk, progressive rock, new wave, Grateful Dead, and bluegrass covers across Northern California and the West Coast.

## 1. Band Identity, Booking & Capabilities
- **Name:** Chum (CHUM — A Tribute to Phish)
- **Founded:** 2010 in the San Francisco Bay Area, California
- **Track Record:** 200+ live shows performed since 2010 across Northern California, Lake Tahoe, Las Vegas, and Southern California
- **Official Website:** https://chumphishtribute.com/
- **Press Kit:** https://chumphishtribute.com/press.html
- **Live Recordings Archive:** https://archive.org/details/ChumATributeToPhish (47+ full concerts free to stream and download on the Internet Archive Live Music Archive)
- **Booking Contact:** No Brainer Productions (`nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com`)
- **General Inquiries:** `chumphishtribute@gmail.com`
- **Format & Touring Radius:** 4-piece band available for 1-set, 2-set, or 3+ hour shows across San Francisco, Oakland/East Bay, Berkeley, Marin, Sonoma/Napa Wine Country, Santa Cruz, Silicon Valley/Peninsula, Sacramento/Sierra Foothills, Lake Tahoe, and the West Coast.
- **Two Tailorable Setlist Modes:**
  1. **Multi-Era Phish Tribute Show (1.0–4.0):** Deep-cut compositions, complex suites, and open-ended Type II improvisation for ticketed clubs, theaters, and Phish after-parties.
  2. **Crossover Classic Rock, Funk & Jam-Band Set:** High-energy, danceable classic rock, funk, progressive rock, and jam covers tailored for mixed crowds at breweries, wineries, outdoor concert series, festivals, corporate conferences, weddings, and milestone private parties.

## 2. Lineup
- **Eric Ingersoll** — Keyboards & Vocals
- **Chris Detrick** — Guitar & Vocals
- **Chad Kimner** — Bass & Vocals
- **Alex Bowman** — Drums & Vocals
- **Eric Schiff** — Guitar (occasional guest appearances from Sweden)
- *In memory of **John Greene** (Keyboards & Vocals, March 2014 – July 2025)*

## 3. Flagship Venues & Event Resume (200+ Shows Since 2010)
- **Major Concert Halls & Clubs:** Great American Music Hall (San Francisco, CA), The UC Theatre (Berkeley, CA), The Chapel (San Francisco, CA), The Catalyst (Santa Cruz, CA), Terrapin Crossroads — Grate Room, Backyard & Bar (San Rafael, CA), Crystal Bay Casino (Lake Tahoe, NV), Cornerstone Craft Beer & Live Music (Berkeley, CA), Felton Music Hall (Felton, CA), Moe's Alley (Santa Cruz, CA), HopMonk Tavern (Novato & Sebastopol, CA), Boom Boom Room (San Francisco, CA), Brick & Mortar Music Hall (San Francisco, CA), 19 Broadway & Peri's Tavern (Fairfax, CA), Ivy Room (Albany, CA), Don Quixote's & The Crepe Place (Santa Cruz, CA), Woodhouse Blending & Brewing (Santa Cruz, CA), Art Boutiki (San Jose, CA), Milk Bar (San Francisco, CA), Green Room Social Club (Placerville, CA), Crazy Horse Saloon (Nevada City, CA), Saint Rocke (Hermosa Beach / Los Angeles, CA).
- **Corporate, Stadium, Festival & Private Events:** Dreamforce (Salesforce annual conference — multiple years), Oakland Ballers Stadium (Oakland, CA), Shakedown at Tuscany Suites & Copa Room (Las Vegas Phish Sphere After-Parties), Commodore SF Bay Boat Cruise, Weddings (Hacienda de las Flores in Moraga, Terrapin Crossroads Wedding), Milestone 50th Birthday Parties, and Neighborhood Block Parties.

## 7. Critical Reception & Press Quotes
- **Surrender to the Flow (Dick's 2026 Issue — "Phish Tributes: Capturing the Feeling I Forgot" by Sydne Kasle):**
  Featured alongside Pink Talking Fish, The Last Rewind, and Kids Under the Carpet.
  - On multi-era Phish repertoire: *"...it's less about adapting to how Phish has evolved and more about being willing to sample from any of those eras on any given night."*
  - On live improvisation: *"Learning the hard stuff is academic. Learning to create new music in real time is the much more elusive goal."* — Chad Kimner
- **Santa Cruz Sentinel (March 19, 2025):**
  *"Phish tribute band Chum quite the catch at Woodhouse Brewing"* (`https://www.santacruzsentinel.com/2025/03/19/santa-cruz-phish-tribute-band-chum-quite-the-catch-at-woodhouse-brewing/`)
- **Tyler Blue (Veteran Music Promoter):**
  *"Very few bands out there even dare to embrace the intricate discipline of executing these songs properly. San Francisco's Chum has earned elite status amongst the Phish community with their rare ability to capture the essence of the band's razor-sharp precision, organic improvisation and playful spirit. From 1.0 to 4.0, they have it all dialed. Even the most jaded vets nod in approval."*
